node.title: A=1 core-one middle-Hankel adjugate factorization
node.statement: On the half-distance A=1 core-one maximal-degree face, contraction produces a square symmetric middle-Hankel pencil M of size d+1 and generic rank d. If q is the primitive degree-e residual apolar coefficient vector, then adj(M)=lambda*q*q^T for one nonzero linear form lambda. The gcd of every nonzero maximal minor is exactly lambda, which is the unique size-one regular Kronecker block. The pencil has rank d away from its one projective root and rank d-1 there. All residual root omission is concentrated at that slope; on sharp cap O is 0 or 1 and the norm residual degree is e-1+O. This is an exact coefficient-chain interface, not a stratum exclusion.
